name: dev-local-setup
description: Scaffold a one-command `dev-local` launcher for ANY codebase. Investigates the repo to find its services, ports, and infra dependencies, then generates a single `scripts/dev-local.sh` (up/down/status/logs/restart) that runs every dev server in one tmux session, plus a short skill doc describing it. Use when someone says "set up dev-local", "make a one-command dev launcher", "I want one script to start this repo", "scaffold dev-local for this project".

metadata.semantic_review: Deterministic source-declaration promotion; runtime not tested.
